summary: VolitionRx Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,960,000 common shares plus warrants (one-half share per share) at $1.55 per combined unit, with a pre-funded warrant option for beneficial ownership limits. Maxim Group LLC acts as placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis. The offering is a capital raise and does not constitute a special situation; it is a routine shelf takedown. No deal terms, target, or strategic event apply. This filing is a standard equity offering, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation.
